name: Safety and Justice Council (Mikva Challenge)
what_you_do: Youth who live in Chicago or Cook County give advice to the Cook County Board President. They talk about youth justice, safety in the community and holding police responsible. They write advice each year.
grades: Citywide Youth Councils are for current 9th to 11th graders
who_can_apply: Youth ages 16 to 20 who live in Chicago or Cook County.
pay_detail: Pay not stated on the program page. Ask Mikva Challenge.
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Recruitment for 2027 starts in the spring. Watch the Mikva Challenge program application page or email inquiries@mikvachallenge.org. Phone: (312) 863-6340.
notes: The council includes young people affected by the juvenile justice system. The age range here is 16 to 20, so some members are over 18 and teens work alongside older youth.
